name: @fabianmossberg/fabpix
description: Search, preview and download stock photos from Pexels (and more) right in your terminal
author: Fabian Mossberg

scripts.build: bun build src/cli.ts --target=node --outfile=dist/fabpix.js --banner='#!/usr/bin/env node' && chmod +x dist/fabpix.js
scripts.compile:all: for t in darwin-arm64 darwin-x64 linux-x64 linux-arm64; do bun build src/cli.ts --compile --target=bun-$t --outfile=bin/fabpix-$t; done
